book.name: Genesis
book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Yakopva Aralm Kandaspolm Omnana, Noinda Aralva Hemba Awothona.
Doa Isakmba mundkola venamba, novtit vevna. Doa hev ona, kavna yiveltowond Esau prora. Pronamba, omnana, omb, wo he omnana aralm, men kava lohv.
Doa aral omnana, doa kava mundkolal lohv, si lelnam kamba dahavmi.
Yeoa pevna bunevalgooa dombrava, wo kamoa tatapetaoa lomno.
Lomnarava, weiharava, os kamoa wulsihamno. Omnana, yimba kamba doa sihamnana, ata kava nerava, yemba ata kava Sesoam osahmanavav, mindnam kolvro, manara yimba kana yiveltowond lohv.
Doa Isakva hevna yiveltowondm ishomnavna, ongalva poaita avna, hellewulavna. Doa Esauva nesam gana,
avalva Yakopm ishomnana, os doa kava hellei, arapevpa yenamba etepevm ishomni, os omni,
tatapetaoa kamoa lomno, lomnarava, weiharava, wo os kava ata nevav. Nepiarava, ata os kava Yawemba kolvrelmomba ishomnavav, osm yem awotholm, manara si kamba dahavav.
Doa avalva mendah Yakopm ishongamnavna, wo yeoa kana moam hellevm,
memetatanaindam garava, wo otol samblam holvorawollava, hom wonproo naembulnangas. Ata kava weithavav, osm arapevpa yenamba mindnam nengmanavra.
Weitharava, yeoa os guamno, ata nerava, ata Sesoamba os osahmanavav yeinda, etepevindava owai.
Doa Yakop omnana, owai, Esauva mindnam talna lohv, kava owai, yimba nonora.
Wo aramba englava kaindava holothotava, ata os nengvav, kava Esauva owai, noinda ata Sesoamba osahmanavav kamba helvelmba.
Doa aval omnana, kamba helvetava homeista, doa lelnam gao.
Doa himba ganamba, memeotol samblam wonpro, doa aval weitha, osm aral mindnam nengvra.
Doa avalva Esauna kayen besal dombna hevna deuvrini, ten nalohvnam, doa Yakopm vewol venana.
Doa hev henga memetov vranamba, Yakopinda holowohamnana, vei englara eva wangra.
Doa tatanihil vetrahona rotinahonam, omnana, ingamno arapevm.
Doa Yakop inganamba, aralm omnana, ara men kava lohv. Doa aral omnana, yimba heni, ora yiveltowond ora kalel?
Doa hev omnana, kava yiveltowond Esau, gekala omnavna. Os kava vev, ye ten oim. Yeoa phorava, tataoa honaoa nevm, nerava, Sesoam mindnam sahmano kaindam pevna yiveltowondindam.
Doa aral omnana, yimba ambo lelnam loi, es hevpa? Doa kalel omnana, Yawe kam kolvrei, ten pev lohmanavm, noinda kava lelnamba nonglai. Heva os gekala omnavna.
Doa aral omnana, murapetam proo, yena nihm ka kevravai. Yimba Esaumi ora owai?
Doa kalel murapetam ganamba, aral englaval kevra, omnana, yena moalamangva Yakopna, heva os englava yenamba Esauna.
Aralva englavalva kevranamoa, memetovm kevrana talnahonam, ona, Esauna tal.
Doa aralva kalelm omnana, tanamolnam yimba Esauma?, wo he omnana, eie, gekala omnavna.
Doa aral omnana, tatanihil kam vetraho, boasna kava nerava, os ata kava Sesoamba osahmanavav. Doa kalel vetrahonamba, doa wainpol wulkamna.
Doa nenamba, henga kalelm omnana, murapetam proo, kam sendara othoo.
Doa kalelva murapetam ganamba, aralm sendara otho. Doa aral teihnunglaku vene kayenm, ona, lehra besal hevm teihnung venav, oi osothnung, temba Yawe doa beswonam vrenam.
Wo Sesoaoa pomoa wolaihaprara yena osoram, wo yena innemba mindnam phovav, wo mindnam yena deuvrava nalohvav osonna eva wainpol.

Sesoa hev vevav, yena keusingi lovahvav indkumbiva, wo himba hevna kuva yem kusithapramnavav. Wo yetatanamba indkumbiva hillivav yena moamba, hevna kuva yem kusithapramnavav. Sesoa hev vevra, anvemamba yemba indkokla ovretava, eva henomba sahokla vevavta hevmba, wo anvemamba yemba beswonam ovrerava, osva Sesoa henomba kolvrowol vevav. Doa.
Yiveltowond Yakopm Osahmanana, Kamoa Eva Awothota.
Doa aralva awothonamba, Yakopva pholahanga. Doa wenokombava venamoa owai, Esau prona, tatapeta wulprona.
Weihanamba, os besva vevna i, doa aralm guamnanamba, omnana, phorava, hona tatapetaoa nerava, doa os Sesoam osahmano kaindam, pev ten oim.
Doa aral omnana, an yimba? Ona, kava Esau, kava yena yiveltowond.

Doa aralmba mindnam eisvna englamonglanahonam, ona, an hevpa tatamba loi, wo kaindam wulproi, men kava daipotangas nei? Temba henomba wulproiva, doa kava Sesoam osahmani, mindnam kolvro, wo honamba kolvrelmomba heinda wohlohmanavav, yeindamba owai.
Doa yiveltowondva hellenamba, himba sahonam ambo nengvna, wo eva wi vevna esvema, omnana, Sesoam osahmanota eva kaindam.
Doa aral omnana, kava owai, es eva, boaslapevpa yenamba kamba deswuhai, doa kolvrelmomba heinda wohphoi.

Doa yiveltowond omnana, memba daipotava himba yemba kandaspolm omni, doarava kamba os eva omnanata. Wo honanamba pimba os ningthiv, Yakopva himba deswuhanindrini lohv. Seilva doarava kamba omnana, pina arana puewulva si kavna englisra nalohvav, yeindava owai. Wo daipotava yemba kandaspolm omni, wo yena kolvrelmomba heinda doa wohphoi, temba yimba kamba isholm venavnamba. Es hevpa yimba wulluhvma moamba, kamba kolvrevma?

Doa aral omnana owai, moamba kanamba doa kava Yakopm indthoai, osm yena kuwulalm lohvav si. Owalva indkumbiva si hena anglasingi lovahmanavav. Kana moamba doa kava ishowol vei, osonna eva wainpol mindnam heindava nalohmanavav, kava eva es yemba kolvrevav, owai.
Doa yiveltowondva nihnapehna ovna, wivevna, ara, kamoa eva awothota.
Doa aral omnana, pomba yena osorava si veihavavmoa, wo innemba si phovavmoa beswonamba.
Yimba daosmomangas ishomana vevra, bunenam velm. Wo yimba si boaslapevna anglasingi lohvav, wo sism si yimba wohgavav, yimba si os nengvav, himba kamba ondal ovrevavmoa.

Doa yiveltowondva os mindnam wuspromnavna boaslalmba, manara aralva doa kolvrelmomba ishomni boaslalm, hemba owai. Doa himba os nengna, aramba si lelnam kanamba dahavav, wo nonamta si kava kavna boaslalmba helvakomandhavav.
Doa avalva hellenamba, ona, Yakop prora, doa pronamba, aval omnana, etepevpa yemba helvakomandhalm vev, manara, yimba doa arapevm kandaspolm omnana, wo yiveltowondna kolvrelmomba yeinda wohphona.
Doa beswonam hello, lelnam hona kembelmoa wuleiho, nnopovindam Lapanindam gao Harandam.
Wo di dawonam avhoao, etepevna nonam und lohvhoapihamnavra.

Si yena indkoklamba maivethavav, wo nonamba kava mongom indhanarinim wolaihapravav, yem waiprolm hom. Si homeis Esauim yeim hoai vewolvm mongawakombanam. Memba osra, si homeis Esau yemba helvakomandhavm, wo mongo indhanarini hemba helvakomandhavav.
Doa Repekava Isakm tlalm omnana, kamba gimus venav Esauna ungund ongorini samblara. Hitnindongorini himba ahav, wo Yakopva snamba vratava, osva kamba si wuspromana vevav, verava daha.
